pitch: B-natural, high pitch. Built in B-flat Chorton.
mouthpiece: Not original. See instrument 16312 for mouthpiece with which this instrument was associated when it was part of the collection of Paul de Wit.
literature: *Heyde 1980a: 16, 170-71, tafel 24 (photo); Langwill 1980: 45; Fischer 1984: 43; SmithD 1989: 30; Myers A 1998; Herbert 2004.
remarks: 7 positions; bell at 4th position. Repair in bell section. Detailed bore measurements and graph showing bore profile in Myers A 1998.
